sync.text: Make a new folder in OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive or Google Drive, choose it here, then the same folder on your other computers. Tasks, files and memory follow you; settings and keys stay on each computer.
sync.safe: Your tasks, files and memory are also in {folder}, safe even if your browser clears them here.
sync.waiting: Allow access to {folder} to go on syncing with your other computers.
sync.failed: {folder} can’t be reached. Is it still on this computer?
sync.refused: {folder} holds other files. Choose a new, empty folder, or the one you sync with on another computer.
